thread:
incident-bot: [PAGER] otel-exporter:lightstep failing — auth errors (401/403) and token refresh failures observed, traces not being accepted. Paging @rose (oncall). incident id INC-20260520-0734

rose: ack. pulling collector logs and secret manager state. any vendor status page links?

samir: Lightstep status shows no broad outage but they reported "auth service degradation" for a rolling subset of tokens in us-west-2: https://status.lightstep.com/2026/05/20/auth-service-degradation

taylor: otel-collector logs: 
```
2026-05-20T07:34:05Z ERROR exporter/lightstep: auth failed, token invalid (401)
2026-05-20T07:34:06Z WARN exporter/lightstep: token-refresh attempt failed: http 502 from token service
2026-05-20T07:34:12Z INFO queue: buffered_batches=11400
```

piper: secret-manager shows no manual rotations in the last 24h. We rotate tokens automatically via sts-assume-role -> kube secret injection. AWS STS reported elevated latencies earlier in the day; maybe refreshes failing due to STS throttling.

infra-bot: Confirmed: STS request rate from observability role spiked ~3x at 07:30 UTC. Recommend reducing token churn or switching to long-lived fallback key for a short window. Warning: long-lived keys increase risk vector.

rose: mitigation options: A) create a short-lived alternate API token in Lightstep and roll to a canary of collectors, B) fallback to file exporter to avoid queue/OOM, C) reduce sampling and increase backoff, D) put collectors into buffering mode that drops traces (noop) to avoid pressure. Given auth path flaky, I'd prefer A (rotate token) + B as fallback. Thoughts?

samir: creating alternate API token now requires Lightstep console and possibly manual approval from SE. If we can't get a token quickly, file exporter is fastest. We can also patch the kube secret with an encoded token via kubectl set secret. Prepared patch steps for both paths.

taylor: quick patch to switch to file exporter (safe) and to set path to /var/otel/buffer/lightstep.ndjson:
```yaml
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: otel-collector
        env:
        - name: OTEL_EXPORTER
          value: "file"
        - name: OTEL_FILE_PATH
          value: "/var/otel/buffer/lightstep.ndjson"
```

piper: if we do rotate API token, keep in mind our KMS/HSM policy needs approval for exporting the token. I'll start lightstep SE chat and request a rotational token for the infra account. Meanwhile, canary to file exporter seems fastest.

rose: applying canary (2 pods) to file exporter now. monitoring queue and token-request logs.

(07:41 UTC) rose: canary applied to 2 pods. queue decreased from 11.4k -> 2.6k in 6m. Collector retries to Lightstep dropped accordingly.

samir: Lightstep SE replied: they're investigating token refresh failures and suggested creating a new ingest token as a workaround. They can generate a scoped token for us if we confirm the project and role.

taylor: good. I'll prepare a k8s secret patch to inject the temporary token once we have it. snippet: 
```bash
kubectl -n observability create secret generic lightstep-temporary-token --from-literal=API_KEY=<<TOKEN>> --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
kubectl -n observability patch deploy otel-collector --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/1/valueFrom/secretKeyRef/name","value":"lightstep-temporary-token"}]'
```

piper: also note: if we inject a new token without updating the token refresh workflow, collectors may still trigger STS calls when they try to rotate. Consider setting OTEL_TOKEN_TTL to a longer value temporarily.

infra-bot: Auto-scale and latency systems unaffected. Risk: if we keep buffering too long, collectors may run out of disk (monitor PVC). Set disk alert at 70% while buffering.

rose: applying file-exporter to full fleet in 10m if canary remains stable. Also starting request with Lightstep SE to issue temporary token.

(07:55 UTC) rose: Lightstep provided temporary ingest token via SE DM. rotating to canary collectors now with the temp token and keeping file exporter as fallback.

samir: deployed new secret and patched 3 collectors to use new token. auth success logs: 
```
2026-05-20T07:58:02Z INFO exporter/lightstep: auth success, token accepted
2026-05-20T07:58:03Z INFO exporter/lightstep: batch exported size=120
```

rose: rolling token update to rest of collectors now. Will monitor for duplicate sends or missing spans. Reminder: stop gap token expires in 6h — plan for a permanent fix once Lightstep confirms root cause.

taylor: replay strategy when vendor fully recovered: if we buffered to file, use replay tool that preserves trace IDs and timestamps. If we used noop/drop mode for any subset, those traces are lost. Replay example (file):
```bash
cat /var/otel/buffer/lightstep.ndjson | lightstep-replay --api-key $LIGHTSTEP_KEY --project redwood-prod --verify
```

piper: make sure replay tool can sign requests correctly and uses same service.name mapping. Also include dedupe tolerance in case some batches were accepted during token flaps.

rose: customer impact update: alerted SREs and a couple of customers who rely on traces for incident debugging. No direct user-facing errors. Logging/metrics unaffected. CS/PM notified.

oncall-bot: Handoff scheduled: rose -> piper at 12:00 UTC. Please add notes to INC-5901.

rose: created incident ticket INC-5901: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-5901 (labels: observability, vendor-auth, buffered_exports). Notes: temporary token injected, full fleet updated, file exporter fallback enabled earlier, queued spans buffered to disk. Next steps: - coordinate with Lightstep for permanent token rotation + root cause - schedule replay window within token validity - validate replay with replay-verify tool - adjust OTEL_TOKEN_TTL and reduce STS churn.

piper: taking handoff. I'll keep monitoring token expiry alarms and disk usage. If Lightstep doesn't confirm a permanent fix within 4h, we'll schedule a postmortem and consider switching to alternate vendor for critical services.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260520-0734 updated: status=partially_mitigated (temporary token injected, exports resumed; buffered file fallback in place). last_update=2026-05-20T08:10:00Z

piper: acknowledged. leaving additional notes: replay validation script added to ticket; set disk alert to 75%; created status page blurb draft for tracing gaps. Any urgent asks before handoff?

samir: add runbook note: if STS spikes again, set OTEL_TOKEN_TTL=3600 and pause frequent re-assume-role paths; use token caching library to reduce calls. Also log token refresh latencies to correlate with STS flags.

rose: thanks team. closing my active loop and handing to @piper. :thumbsup:
